keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «기계 학습에서 컴퓨터는 많은 데이터를 공부하며 스스로 패턴을 찾는다(원리)» 와 «배우는 로봇은 강력한 도구이지만, 사람이 그 쓰임에 책임을 질 때 가장 잘 작동한다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the principle (in machine learning, a computer studies large amounts of data and finds patterns by itself) and the conclusion (robots that learn are powerful tools, but they work best when people remain responsible for how they are used). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why can learning machines make strange errors?
qs.qko: 학습하는 기계는 왜 이상한 실수를 할 수 있나요?
opts: Because they face situations that are different from their training
Because programmers write every rule by hand
Because they never use any data
evs: A factory robot, for example, might repeat the same movement thousands of times a day without any change.
They need huge amounts of data and energy, and they can make strange errors when they face situations that are different from their training.
A robot arm may drop an object many times before it learns how to grip it gently.
Few experts expected the machine to win.
why: 학습하는 기계는 훈련받은 것과 다른 상황을 만나면 이상한 실수를 할 수 있다고 나와요.
The text says they can make strange errors when they face situations that are different from their training.

qs.q: In the text, what does 'trial and error' mean?
qs.qko: 글에서 'trial and error(시행착오)' 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: Following one fixed rule without any change
Trying again and again and learning from mistakes
Asking a human to do the job instead
evs: Traditional robots follow exact instructions written by programmers.
A robot arm may drop an object many times before it learns how to grip it gently.
This ability is based on machine learning, a branch of artificial intelligence.
For these reasons, experts stress that humans must test, monitor, and guide learning machines carefully.
why: 로봇 팔이 물건을 여러 번 떨어뜨린 뒤에야 부드럽게 잡는 법을 배운다고 했어요. 여러 번 시도하고 실수하면서 배운다는 뜻이에요.
A robot arm drops an object many times before it learns to grip it gently. It means learning by trying and making mistakes.

qs.q: How could AlphaGo win even though no programmer told it which moves to make?
qs.qko: 어떤 프로그래머도 둘 수를 알려 주지 않았는데, 알파고는 어떻게 이길 수 있었을까요?
opts: A programmer secretly told it the best moves
It repeated the same move thousands of times without any change
It studied large amounts of data and found patterns by itself
evs: In machine learning, a computer is not told every rule directly.
Traditional robots follow exact instructions written by programmers.
Instead, it studies large amounts of data and finds patterns by itself.
A factory robot, for example, might repeat the same movement thousands of times a day without any change.
why: 기계 학습에서는 컴퓨터에게 모든 규칙을 직접 알려 주지 않아요. 대신 많은 데이터를 공부하며 스스로 패턴을 찾아요. 이 두 문장을 알파고 이야기와 연결해 보세요.
In machine learning, a computer is not told every rule; it studies lots of data and finds patterns by itself. Connect these two sentences to the AlphaGo story.
